name: menhir-room-moved
prompt: The leaning standing stone has now been moved fully aside and rests against the chamber wall at the right, clearing the floor completely; a broad drag-mark crosses the dust where it travelled.
extra: The shaft of light still falls at exactly the same angle onto the same patch of floor, now empty.

name: carousel-room-stopped
prompt: The drifting motion-blur and swirling dust that suggested the room was turning are gone. Everything is sharp and dead still, and the dust has settled into a thin even layer across the floor.
extra: All eight passage mouths keep their exact spacing and their brass surrounds.

name: aquarium-room-broken
prompt: The great glass wall of the aquarium has shattered: jagged glass teeth remain in the frame, the water has poured out across the floor in a dark flood, and the tank behind is empty and dripping.
extra: The frame of the tank, the room's stonework and the lantern keep their exact positions.

name: pool-room-drained
prompt: The pool has drained away completely. The stone basin it filled is now empty, its floor dark with wet silt and a few shallow puddles, the tide-line clearly marked around the rim.
extra: The basin's outline in the floor is exactly as it was.

name: machine-room-cage-open
prompt: The steel cage's barred door now stands wide open, swung outward on its hinges, the cage interior empty and dark.
extra: Every lever, dial and gear keeps its exact position; only the cage door moves.

name: low-room-quiet
prompt: The sweeping curved lines drawn in the iron dust on the floor are gone; the dust now lies flat, even and undisturbed.
extra: The low ceiling and every arched exit keep their exact positions.

name: topiary-moved
prompt: The clipped hedge animals have moved: each one now stands in a different place along the path and faces a different way, as though they had all shifted while unobserved. The gravel is scuffed where they passed.
extra: The garden walls, the path's line and the flat shadowless light are unchanged; the animals are the same animals.

name: dragon-lair-empty
prompt: The dragon is gone. The scorched hollow it lay in is empty, the bones and dull treasure around it undisturbed, a faint haze of smoke still hanging in the air above the hollow.
extra: The hollow's shape, the bone heap, the treasure and the shaft of light are exactly as they were.

name: cerberus-room-collared
prompt: A heavy studded collar has been buckled around one of the three-headed hound's necks, and the beast has settled back on its haunches, all three heads lowered and calm rather than snarling.
extra: The door, its iron banding, the gouges in the stone and the torchlight are unchanged.

name: guarded-room-sniffing
prompt: The lizard head embedded in the door has turned slightly toward the viewer and its nostrils are flared, sniffing the air with obvious interest.
extra: The door's position, its stains and iron banding, the cobwebs and the tracks in the dust are unchanged.
